items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He used to find him to come get me, you know. He used to ask me what I'm playing.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know what a dirty mouth he had. He's my mouth, don't you?

Yeah. He was a dirty fellow. Talk dirty. Yeah, he had the women, 30 women. They'd be crazy about it. Yeah. A towel across his shoulder. What, a towel across his shoulder? Yeah. Why? He used to find him to come get me, you know. He used to ask me what I'm playing. I said, I don't want to tell you anything. He's a son, my buddy. And I didn't want to tell you, but they said he wasn't playing with him no more. Well, I would go with him, you know. What band was that? Well, he was tired of. So what band was that? What…
